e.title: Klein Auto Research：让 AI 智能体在「可验证的研究纪律」内工作（预测先于证据登记、逐次运行存证、独立裁判）
e.title_en: Klein Auto Research: making an AI agent work inside a verifiable research discipline (predictions registered before evidence, every run notarised, an independent referee)
e.title_hk: Klein Auto Research：讓 AI 智能體在「可驗證的研究紀律」內工作（預測先於證據登記、逐次運行存證、獨立裁判）
e.summary: 面向精算与数据科学的开源智能体研究框架：把研究纪律做成智能体运行的「实验记录本」——预测在证据出现前登记、每次运行以 git 存证、结论强度须被挣得、任何结论在被称为发现前须过独立裁判；Python ≥3.11，数据集随仓库捆绑或本地生成，无需凭证与下载
e.summary_en: An open-source agentic research framework for actuaries and data scientists that makes research discipline the lab notebook the agent runs inside: predictions registered before their evidence, every run notarised in git, claim strength earned rather than asserted, and an independent referee before anything is called a finding; Python ≥3.11, with every needed dataset bundled or generated locally and no credentials or downloads required
e.summary_hk: 面向精算與數據科學的開源智能體研究框架：把研究紀律做成智能體運行的「實驗記錄本」——預測在證據出現前登記、每次運行以 git 存證、結論強度須被掙得、任何結論在被稱為發現前須過獨立裁判；Python ≥3.11，數據集隨倉庫捆綁或本地生成，無需憑證與下載
e.body:
**Klein Auto Research** 是一个面向精算与数据科学的智能体研究框架（仓库 `Xiang-Shan/klein-auto-research`），**MIT 许可，实测 ★2、fork 1、主语言 Python、仓库体量 30,802 KB、创建于 2026-07-10、最后推送 2026-09-08**（**均 GitHub API 实测值**）；**其仓库 topics 逐字实测为 actuarial-science、agentic-research、ai-agents、claude-code、insurance、machine-learning、optimization、research-framework、simulation、tabular-data**。本条目属于本轮主题**「可核实性的四种做法」**中的**第二种：靠过程（process）****——**也是最贴合本词条所在站点自身方法论的一条**。

可核实信息（**均由 GitHub API 与 README 逐字实测**）：**README 实测 18,658 字节**，其首段逐字为 **「Process-verifiable research for AI for Science. Klein is the lab-notebook discipline an AI agent runs *inside*: predictions registered before their evidence, every run notarized in git, claims whose strength is earned, an independent referee before anything is called a finding.」**——**即它把研究纪律做成了智能体运行其中的**实验记录本****：**① 预测先于证据登记；② 每次运行在 git 中存证；③ 主张的强度是「挣来的」而非声称的；④ 任何东西在被称作「发现」之前要过一名独立裁判**。⭐ **可执行的证据（README 逐字实测）**：**需要 Python ≥3.11、uv 与 git，且「No credentials and no downloads: every dataset an exhibit needs is bundled or generated」**——**无需凭证、无需下载，每个示例所需数据集要么随仓库捆绑、要么本地生成**；**实测命令含 `uv run --no-sync klein doctor`（本机可跑什么，不取任何东西）与 `uv run --no-sync klein verify --study studies/00-known-truth-quickstart --numbers`**；⭐ **并实测到产物中的 `claims.lock` 文件，README 逐字称「every number on that page has a home there」**——**报告页面上每一个数字在 `claims.lock` 里都有一个可追溯的出处**；**另有两个更长检查**：**pytest 测试套件**，以及 **`scripts/verify_shipped_studies.py` 重新验证每一个随仓库发布的账本——README 逐字称这是「the same proof CI runs on every push」**（**每次推送时 CI 跑的同一套证明**）。**可选扩展实测**：**`--extra gbdt` 引入 LightGBM/XGBoost/CatBoost**、**`--extra deep` 引入 PyTorch**。**README 章节结构逐字实测**：**Quickstart (5 minutes) / Why Klein / One kernel, any inquiry / Run it on your own question / ⭐ Detection limit: audit headroom before spending challengers / The generation layer (opt-in, since 2.1) / Drive it with your agent — or none / The shipped studies / ⭐ Limitations / ⭐ Harness or skill? Both — a harness that carries a skill / Layout / Lineage & citing**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「predictions registered before their evidence（预测先于证据登记）」是本轮最有价值的一条**——**这正是**预注册（pre-registration）**这一科研诚信机制，被搬进了 AI 智能体的工作流**；**对精算学生，这条直接对应一个真实痛点：**模型是智能体跑出来的，读者凭什么相信这个结果不是调出来的****；**预注册把「调参直到好看」这一空间提前封死**（**可与池内 [[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[verified-reserving]]、[[actuarial-benchmarks]] 并读——**那三条分别从可复现、可验证与基准比较三个角度处理同一问题，而 Klein 补的是**过程顺序**这一维度：证据与预测的先后****）。**② ⭐⭐ 「claims.lock：页面上每个数字都有出处」是一个可直接借鉴的工程做法**——**把报告里的数字与产生它的那次运行**机械绑定****，**而不是靠作者自觉**；**这与池内 [[claude-code]] 之类的编码智能体形成互补：后者让智能体**写**代码，前者让智能体**交账****（**可与 [[phi-boundary-gate]] 的边界门控、[[ins-mmbench]] 的基准评测并读：都是「在结论出门前设一道必须通过的关」**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 「an independent referee before anything is called a finding」是三个机制里最贵的一个**——**前面两条靠工具即可强制，而独立裁判意味着**不是自己判自己****；**词条内不主张它真的是独立第三方（README 未如此说明，本次亦未核实裁判的实现方式）**——**这正是本词条所在站点反复强调的一点：机制的名称不等于机制的强度**。**④ ⭐ 「Harness or skill? Both — a harness that carries a skill」这一章节标题值得单独记一笔**——**它把本轮之前几轮一直在讨论的「工具（harness）与技能（skill）之别」显式地作为设计问题提出，并给出「一个是承载另一个」的答案**；**实测其仓库内含 `.claude/skills/klein/scripts/tests` 路径，与该自我描述一致**（**⚠️ 本词条不据此展开其 skill 形态，仅如实记录路径存在**）。**⑤ ⭐ 「Detection limit: audit headroom before spending challengers」是一个统计学味很重的章节名**——**「在花掉挑战者（检验）之前先审计余量」接近**功效分析（power analysis）**的思路：先确认这套数据能分辨多大的效应，再决定值不值得做检验**；**这与池内 [[insurance-conformal]]、[[insurance-quantile]] 所代表的「先量化不确定性再下结论」同属一类纪律**（**本次未读该章节正文，故不转述其具体判据**）。**⑥ ⭐ 「Why Klein」「Limitations」两章并置值得注意**——**一个工具主动写出自己的局限**（**本次未读 Limitations 正文，故不转述其自述边界**）。**⑦ ⭐ 「每个示例数据集捆绑或本地生成、无需凭证与下载」对教学场景有直接价值**——**课堂上最常卡住的不是方法而是环境**；**README 逐字称 `klein doctor` 用于说明本机能跑什么且不取任何东西**（**本次未运行任何命令，故不主张其实际可跑通**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据（★2、fork 1、MIT、Python、30,802 KB、创建与推送时间）、topics 十项、README 全文（18,658 字节）的标题结构与其中逐字引用的关键段落与命令名**，⭐ **但 README 的多数章节正文（含 Limitations、Detection limit、shipped studies、generation layer）本次仅读到标题，未读正文**，**未克隆仓库、未安装、未运行任何命令、未跑 pytest 或 verify 脚本、未打开任何生成的报告**，因此**不能转述其机制的具体实现、判据、局限自述或随仓库发布的示例研究内容**；**② ⭐⭐ 「独立裁判」为**README 自述**——**词条内明确不主张其为真正独立第三方，其实现方式与独立性本次未核实**；**③ ⭐ ★2 说明关注度很低**，**不主张其成熟度、稳定性或被采用情况**，**亦不主张其在真实研究场景中已被验证有效**；**④ 「process-verifiable（过程可验证）」是**项目自述的定位**，**本次未独立检验其是否真的做到**；**⑤ 「for actuaries & data scientists」为**仓库描述自述**，**其精算专用程度本次未核实**；**⑥ 该框架与 Claude/智能体平台的绑定程度、是否需要付费服务本次未核实**（**topics 含 claude-code，但其依赖关系未核实**）；**⑦ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/Xiang-Shan/klein-auto-research` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取；**未克隆、未安装、未运行**。

e.body_en:
**Klein Auto Research** is an agentic research framework for actuaries and data scientists (repository `Xiang-Shan/klein-auto-research`), **MIT licensed, with measured ★2, 1 fork, Python as the primary language, a 30,802 KB repository, created 2026-07-10 and last pushed 2026-09-08** (**all GitHub API measurements**); **its repository topics measurably read actuarial-science, agentic-research, ai-agents, claude-code, insurance, machine-learning, optimization, research-framework, simulation and tabular-data**. It belongs to the second of this round’s four approaches to verifiability: **relying on process** — **and it is the entry that most closely mirrors the methodology of the site it lives on**.

Verifiable details (**all measured verbatim from the GitHub API and README**): the **README measures 18,658 bytes** and its opening paragraph states verbatim **"Process-verifiable research for AI for Science. Klein is the lab-notebook discipline an AI agent runs *inside*: predictions registered before their evidence, every run notarized in git, claims whose strength is earned, an independent referee before anything is called a finding."** — **i.e. it turns research discipline into the lab notebook the agent runs inside**: **① predictions registered before their evidence; ② every run notarised in git; ③ claim strength earned rather than asserted; ④ an independent referee before anything is called a finding**. ⭐ **Executable evidence (read verbatim from the README)**: it needs **Python ≥3.11, uv and git, and states "No credentials and no downloads: every dataset an exhibit needs is bundled or generated"**; **the commands measurably include `uv run --no-sync klein doctor` and `uv run --no-sync klein verify --study studies/00-known-truth-quickstart --numbers`**; ⭐ **and a `claims.lock` artefact is measurably present, of which the README says verbatim "every number on that page has a home there"** — **every number on the report page has a traceable origin in `claims.lock`**; **two longer checks are also described**: a **pytest suite**, and **`scripts/verify_shipped_studies.py` re-verifying every shipped ledger — which the README calls "the same proof CI runs on every push"**. **Measurable optional extras**: **`--extra gbdt` brings in LightGBM/XGBoost/CatBoost, `--extra deep` brings in PyTorch**. **README section headings read verbatim**: **Quickstart (5 minutes) / Why Klein / One kernel, any inquiry / Run it on your own question / ⭐ Detection limit: audit headroom before spending challengers / The generation layer (opt-in, since 2.1) / Drive it with your agent — or none / The shipped studies / ⭐ Limitations / ⭐ Harness or skill? Both — a harness that carries a skill / Layout / Lineage & citing**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ "Predictions registered before their evidence" is the round’s most valuable point** — **this is the research-integrity mechanism of pre-registration, moved into an AI agent’s workflow**; **for actuarial students it maps onto a real pain point: the model was produced by an agent, so why should a reader believe the result was not tuned into existence?**; **pre-registration closes off the "tune until it looks good" space in advance** (**readable with [[reproducible-actuarial-work]], [[verified-reserving]] and [[actuarial-benchmarks]] — those three address the same problem through reproducibility, verifiability and benchmarking respectively, while Klein adds the dimension of process ordering: which came first, prediction or evidence**). **② ⭐⭐ "claims.lock: every number on the page has an origin" is a directly borrowable engineering practice** — **it mechanically binds numbers in a report to the run that produced them rather than relying on the author’s diligence**; **this complements coding agents such as [[claude-code]]: those let the agent write code, this makes the agent render accounts** (**readable with the boundary gating of [[phi-boundary-gate]] and the benchmark evaluation of [[ins-mmbench]] — all three place a gate a conclusion must pass before leaving the room**). **③ ⭐⭐ "An independent referee before anything is called a finding" is the most expensive of the three mechanisms** — **the first two can be enforced by tooling, but an independent referee means not judging your own work**; **the entry does not claim it is genuinely an independent third party (the README does not say so and the referee’s implementation was not verified)** — **exactly the point this site keeps making: the name of a mechanism is not its strength**. **④ ⭐ The section heading "Harness or skill? Both — a harness that carries a skill" deserves separate note** — **it raises explicitly, as a design question, the tool-versus-skill distinction discussed in earlier rounds, and answers that one carries the other**; **the repository measurably contains a `.claude/skills/klein/scripts/tests` path consistent with that self-description** (**⚠️ the entry records only that the path exists and does not extrapolate its skill form**). **⑤ ⭐ "Detection limit: audit headroom before spending challengers" is a strongly statistical section title** — **auditing headroom before spending challengers is close to the logic of power analysis: first establish what effect this data can resolve, then decide whether a test is worth running**; **the same discipline as [[insurance-conformal]] and [[insurance-quantile]], which quantify uncertainty before concluding** (**the section body was not read, so its criteria are not restated**). **⑥ ⭐ Placing "Why Klein" and "Limitations" side by side is notable** — **a tool volunteering its own limits** (**the Limitations body was not read, so its self-stated boundaries are not restated**). **⑦ ⭐ That every dataset is bundled or generated locally with no credentials and no downloads has direct teaching value** — **what usually blocks a classroom is not the method but the environment**; **the README states that `klein doctor` reports what this machine can run and fetches nothing** (**no command was run, so the entry does not claim it actually works**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the repository metadata (★2, 1 fork, MIT, Python, 30,802 KB, creation and push dates), ten topics, and the README’s full 18,658 bytes in respect of its heading structure and the key passages and command names quoted verbatim**, ⭐ **but most section bodies (including Limitations, Detection limit, the shipped studies and the generation layer) were read only as headings**, **and the repository was not cloned, installed or run, no pytest or verify script was executed and no generated report was opened**, so **the mechanisms’ concrete implementation, criteria, self-stated limits and shipped example studies cannot be restated**; **② ⭐⭐ "Independent referee" is a README self-description** — **the entry explicitly does not claim it is genuinely an independent third party, and neither its implementation nor its independence was verified**; **③ ⭐ ★2 indicates very low attention**, **so no maturity, stability or adoption is claimed**, **nor that it has been shown effective in real research settings**; **④ "Process-verifiable" is the project’s own positioning**, **not independently tested here**; **⑤ "for actuaries & data scientists" is the repository description’s own wording**, **and how actuarial-specific it really is was not verified**; **⑥ how tightly the framework binds to Claude or agent platforms, and whether paid services are required, were not verified** (**its topics include claude-code, but the dependency was not verified**); **⑦ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/Xiang-Shan/klein-auto-research` and `/readme` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11; **nothing was cloned, installed or run**.
